_comment: When actions can fire, for the smart conflict check: two actions on one key only count as a conflict when they share a situation. Copy this file to config/keycaps/situations.json to change it. A rule's 'match' is a regular expression, searched in '<action id> <category or mod name>' in lower case; the first rule that matches decides. 'when': world (playing, no screen open: the default for key bindings), menu (inventory and container screens), chat, passive (only changes what is shown while held: never a conflict), or any other word for a situation of its own. 'adds': ctrl / alt / shift when the mod adds that key itself, so the action is shown on that layer. 'shares': action ids the action is made to share its key with, never a conflict with those (Litematica's schematic pick block only acts on schematic blocks and leaves the key to Pick Block otherwise). 'needs': the options the action needs ('<class>#<static field>', one or a list: a malilib option such as a Tweakeroo tweak, or a boolean field); while one of them is off the action does nothing, so it is shown as switched off and never counts as a conflict. malilib hotkeys already say whether they also work in screens.
